snippet.title: 10,000 Player Chess
snippet.description:
Hosting is expensive and I had other projects I want to put online, so unfortunately I had to take 10k chess down. No link here :(

If you'd like to revive 10k chess, here's the source code: https://github.com/Serum0017/10kchess . You can play it on your local machine by cloning the repo, installing npm, and running npm start or -- if you are an especially gracious soul -- you can rent a server for others to host. Sorry for the inconvenience, but all good things must come to an end.

Music Used:
Post Elvis - We're Finally Speedrunning | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=doWW79qTtgA
TechnoAxe - Synthwave C | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-WYJ1Jh2kuI
Context Sensitive - Hotline | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOFuHLqXM4Y
The Art of Rally | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=On8HuDmO708
65DaysOfStatic - Supermoon | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PZAM-_5h4QE
Chime - Lifelong | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UDVzaNB0Hso
